data.guideTextData: Those guards won’t give up. Perhaps there’s a way to distract them?

storedDialogues: SANTI (Finally out of that weird forest. Never thought I’d go so out of the way just to catch a break.)
SANTI (Now… That old outpost I saw on the map should be around here somewhere…)
SANTI (A book? It looks pretty fancy, what’s it doing in a place like this?)
SANTI (Hm… Unregulated books are hard to get these days. I should take a look.)
SANTI (... What? The pages are empty. That’s kind of disappointing.)
SANTI (But why does it feel like this book is special somehow?)
SANTI (Wow! That is massive! What is this thing?)
SANTI (Letter blocks? Is this a printing press? I haven’t seen these things before. Especially one so close.)
SANTI (I wonder if the people in Sumpagita know about this? Maybe I could ask the museum to restore it once our problem is over.)
SANTI (An instruction manual, printed on April 8 19XX. Is this for the printing press?)
SANTI (This looks readable… Journal reports, sounds interesting… )
SANTI “Cases of magical attacks?!”
SANTI “There have — reports of assaults of seemingly — happening in the town of Sumpagita."
SANTI "The townsfolk are worried that their katalonans — vengeance or have possibly lost themselves in—”
SANTI (The rest looks too faded to read… I hope Liezel isn’t one of these kinds of people…)
SANTI Huh.
SANTI (Did the Disidensiyang Giyala really win people over with these things? I feel scared just looking at it.)
SANTI All I found were some really old newspapers, posters promoting the old Disidensiya, and a printing press.
LIEZEL Alright. I think I can find that place. If you do not mind, please stay there for the time being.
SANTI I was planning to anyway.
LIEZEL (There is only one outpost like that around Sumpagita. I suppose it is to be expected that my book remained in this area. )
LIEZEL (I should head west. The Disidensiya’s Sumpagita Outpost is over there, just past the forest.)
SANTI (What is this thing? It looks so rusty and dirty… How long has it been here?)
SANTI (Actually this looks familiar… Oh, it’s an emblem of Disidensiya! But why would someone bury it?)
SANTI (Doesn’t matter, maybe it’s still there in Liezel’s time?)
SANTI Liezel, I found this emblem buried near the outpost. Maybe it’s there in your time?
LIEZEL An emblem? That sounds great. Perhaps I can distract the guards with it! I will get back to you Santi, once I find more clues.
SANTI Okay.
LIEZEL (I have this garden spade. I could start digging near the path towards the outpost.)

data.actualQuestTextData: The next step towards the truth.
data.guideTextData: Liezel said she wanted to read a manuscript left at her home, telling Santi to continue exploring.

storedDialogues: ??? It opened on its own, does that mean it worked?
??? I ought to write something quickly, before the person on the other side leaves.
SANTI (What the...)
SANTI (Writing?)
??? Hello there, please do not close this book.
SANTI (It’s... magic? Who in the world would make something like this and leave it here for anyone to find?)
??? My name is Liezel...
LIEZEL ... and it may be hard to believe but I come from your past.
LIEZEL The book in your hands was “sent” to the future, your time, using magic.
LIEZEL If you can see this, please write back.
SANTI (This is suspicious. Nobody would expose themselves as a magic-user these days... But... if they’re really from the past...)
SANTI (Nevermind. Either way, this book is too close to the town. It’s worth investigating. I’ll humor them.)
SANTI Hi.
LIEZEL So it does work! This is excellent. What is your name, stranger?
SANTI Santi. You said you’re from the past?
LIEZEL If my magic worked correctly, yes. I know I am but a stranger to you, but I need your help.
SANTI (My help? What could a person from the past need help from the future for?)
SANTI How do I know this isn’t a trick?
LIEZEL I can assure you that this book cannot do anything except act as a means of communication between our times.
LIEZEL I assume you are a magic-user yourself, are you not? I am merely a katalonan. I am not looking to do any harm.
SANTI I’m no magic user, and it’s still weird to see magic in the open like this. I don’t know if I can trust you.
LIEZEL (They seem suspicious of magic... So is it true that it had a hand in Giyala’s fall? I must learn more, at all costs.)
LIEZEL Please give me a chance. All I need is information. I am not sure what occurred between my time and yours, and why magic has become so taboo for you.
LIEZEL In my time, rumors of magic being evil and mysterious monster attacks have just begun circulating.
LIEZEL But magic is not a tool for harm, nor is it unknowable. If you help me, I can teach you how magic can be used for good.
SANTI (Used for good... In spite of everything that happened, my family always told me to “keep an open mind” about magic. Is this one of those cases?)
SANTI Well then, does one of those uses happen to be a solution for an energy problem?
LIEZEL A what? Is that one of the issues your time is experiencing?
SANTI More like just my town.
LIEZEL I see. Well, there are ways that magic can help with such things, but that will require quite a lengthy explanation.
LIEZEL I am willing to share the information with you if you wish to cooperate.
SANTI (... Shrewd, but alright, fine. Guess there’s no harm in it for me.)
SANTI (And if I can find a way to help Sumpagita...)
SANTI Okay then. What do you want to know?
LIEZEL How about we start with... Where you found this book?
SANTI It’s a ruin near Sumpagita forest. I heard it used to belong to an old revolutionary group, the Disidensiyang Giyala.
LIEZEL (...! Sumpagita? The Disidensiya?)
LIEZEL If you give me more information, I might be able to reach the same place from where I am.
SANTI (I don’t exactly know how to describe this place. I should look around and investigate.)
LIEZEL A spade. This may come in handy.
MANONG GUARD My apologies, Liezel. No one is allowed into the main building at this time.
LIEZEL ... Even me? Why?
LIEZEL (That... is odd. I help write promotional materials occasionally, so I am usually allowed in.)
MANONG GUARD We were not privy to the details, merely under orders to bar anyone from entering.
PARE GUARD That’s right! Nothin’ to see here ma’am. Best you move along! Don’t let the monsters get ya’ though.
PARE GUARD Hehe, unless you want to stay and chat?
MANONG GUARD Ahem, what he meant to say was: please take care and stay away from this building for the time being.
LIEZEL Alright, alright. I understand.
LIEZEL (No use trying to get through to them now. If only I could distract them somehow.)
LIEZEL The guards are blocking my way into the main building. They may be hiding something.
LIEZEL Santi, do you have any ideas as to how I could distract them?
SANTI Uh... I guess I could look around.
SANTI (I’ve already been around these ruins... Maybe I could try the forest?)
LIEZEL Aha, I can use this Garden Spade to dig around here.
LIEZEL (There truly is one here. These emblems are used to distinguish Disidensiya members.)
LIEZEL (I have one myself, not that I remember where I last put it. I typically do not need it for the DG members in this area to recognize me.)
LIEZEL (I should be able to use this to distract the guards in front of the main building.)
MANONG GUARD The main building is still closed for now.
LIEZEL I just wanted to report seeing a woman in distress in the forest. I fear she may have been attacked.
LIEZEL And take a look at this emblem I found nearby, she may even be a fellow member of the Disidensiya.
PARE GUARD Wh-What!? A-A woman in distress!? I must go to her rescue right away!!!
MANONG GUARD W-Wait! Do not rush off! HEY...!
LIEZEL ... Haha, sometimes it really is that simple.
LIEZEL (I won't be needing this Emblem anymore.)
LIEZEL I found a locked chest with an inscription on it. Let me give it a read.
LIEZEL ... It belongs to Servillano.
SANTI Who?
LIEZEL He’s the forefront leader of the Disidensiya.
LIEZEL ... And, coincidentally, my brother-in-law.
LIEZEL (It is a pity that his name does not seem to have survived... But then... How come the Disidensiya’s has?)
LIEZEL (Well, I suppose it is possible that Santi just is not knowledgeable on the Disidensiya’s history.)
LIEZEL In any case, we might be able to unlock this chest by looking for things related to someone named Servillano Solomon.
SANTI Is it okay to just look through his things like that?
LIEZEL We can just return it as we found it. What he does not learn of cannot hurt him.
SANTI ... Uh, if you say so.
LIEZEL (Let me try solving this.)
LIEZEL That was it! I can open the chest now.
LIEZEL What the... These are encoded messages?
SANTI Can you read them?
LIEZEL I am familiar with most ciphers employed by the Disidensiya. But somehow not this one.
LIEZEL Take a look, I can write it down.
SANTI ... Well, not that I expected anything, but I definitely can’t read that.
LIEZEL I will return this chest to the way I found it. It seems the encoded messages were the only thing of value here.
LIEZEL But to hide this under such tight security... Could the Disidensiya leaders be hiding something?
SANTI What do you want to do next? Are we going to try and decode the messages?
LIEZEL Yes, I believe that would be the best course of action. If it turns out to be nothing of note, then we can free the Disidensiya from suspicion.
LIEZEL I want to believe that the Disidensiya is not hiding anything from me, but if I want to get to the bottom of this, I ought to be ready to learn anything.
LIEZEL Please continue investigating the area. I will head back and see if I can uncover more information.
SANTI You know, I still haven’t heard that useful information you promised me...
LIEZEL Haha, I have not forgotten. As it happens, my sister left me a manuscript of her and Servillano’s magic research at our house.
LIEZEL I want to take another look for the sake of this investigation, but it also contains information that might be of interest to you.
LIEZEL About an ore called Salakab.
